meta.name: claude-design-system-architect
meta.description: Generate a complete, premium design system from a brand brief or an existing site — color tokens, type scale, spacing/radius/elevation, motion language, and component specs — exported as Tailwind config, CSS variables, and a usage doc. Built to look editorial and human-crafted, not template-generated. Use when starting a new product/site, unifying an inconsistent UI, or codifying a brand into reusable tokens.

copy.tagline: 从品牌需求生成完整设计系统，输出可用的样式配置与文档。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在启动新产品或需要将品牌视觉整理成可复用的设计系统。
